proof_id_hash.description: Identifier hash of the proof whose dispute reached a decision.

reason_version.description: Version of the stable reason-code policy.

reason_code.description: Stable reason code; no free-form reason or evidence is emitted.

reason_commitment.description: Optional commitment to off-chain rationale, never raw evidence.

resolver.description: Address authorized to finalize the decision.

resolver_role.description: Governed role used to authorize the resolver.

ledger.description: Ledger sequence at which the decision was committed.

timestamp.description: Ledger timestamp at which the decision was committed.

description: Version-2 immutable dispute decision reason and resolver metadata.
